home.title: Ship features, not infrastructure
home.tagline: Beacon is the platform that turns your ideas into production in minutes — no ops, no glue code, no waiting.
home.intro: Trusted by 4,000+ teams to build, launch and scale. Deploy on every push, roll back in one click, and watch it all from a single dashboard.

pricing.includes: Unlimited projects · email support · 5M requests · previews
SSO · SLA · audit logs · unlimited requests · priority support

features.title: Realtime analytics
features.summary: Every request, deploy and error on one live dashboard — no setup.
features.body:
See traffic, latency and errors update as they happen. Drill into any request, filter by route, and share a link to any view.

No agents to install — it works the moment you deploy.

features.title: Deploy on every push
features.summary: Connect a repo and ship. Previews for every branch, rollbacks in one click.
features.body: Push to a branch and get a shareable preview URL. Merge to main and it's live. If anything looks off, roll back instantly — your last ten deploys are always one click away.

features.title: Built-in auth
features.summary: Email, OAuth and SSO out of the box. Sessions, tokens, done.
features.body: Add sign-in with a few lines. Passwordless, social login and enterprise SSO are handled for you, with sessions and refresh tokens managed securely.

features.title: Global edge
features.summary: Your app runs close to every user, automatically.
features.body: Static assets and functions run at the edge in 30+ regions. No config — requests are served from the location nearest each visitor.

features.title: Team collaboration
features.summary: Invite the team, set roles, review changes together.
features.body: Organize work into teams, assign roles, and comment on preview deploys. Everyone sees the same source of truth.

features.title: Open API
features.summary: Automate everything with a clean REST API and CLI.
features.body: Script deploys, pull metrics, manage teams — the whole platform is available over a documented REST API and a first-class CLI.

changelog.title: Edge functions, now in every region
changelog.body: Functions now run at the edge in 30+ regions by default. Cold starts are down 60%, and you can pin a function to a region from the dashboard.

changelog.title: One-click rollbacks
changelog.body: Every deploy is now immutable and instantly restorable. Open any past deploy and promote it to production in a single click.

changelog.title: Realtime analytics dashboard
changelog.body: The new dashboard streams requests, latency and errors live. Filter by route, status or region and share any view with a link.
